description: This file defines an API client module for interacting with backend endpoints, including functions for listing users, sessions, deployments, LLM costs, and health checks. It includes internal helpers for URL building, query parameter handling, and response parsing.

methods.name: isAbsoluteUrl
methods.description: Detects if a URL is absolute (starts with http:// or https://).

methods.name: buildUrl
methods.description: Constructs a full URL by joining a base and a relative path, handling special cases like /api paths and absolute URLs.

methods.name: toQuery
methods.description: Builds a query string from a parameters object, handling arrays and nested objects.

methods.name: isSessionTrackingRoot
methods.description: Checks if a URL path is the root of session tracking collection.

methods.name: sanitizeEndpointParams
methods.description: Sanitizes query parameters based on endpoint rules, e.g., only allowing certain params for /api/users and /api/session-tracking.

methods.name: ensureScopedQueryParams
methods.description: Ensures query parameters include necessary scope identifiers like organization_id or tenant_id based on endpoint.

methods.name: buildUrlWithParams
methods.description: Merges additional parameters into a URL, handling existing query strings.

methods.name: parseResponse
methods.description: Parses fetch response, returning an object with ok, status, and payload (JSON or text).

methods.name: httpGet
methods.description: Performs a GET request with URL building, parameter scoping, and response parsing.

methods.name: httpJson
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request with JSON body, including URL building, parameter scoping, and response parsing.

methods.name: normalizeListPayload
methods.description: Normalizes list responses to include items, total count, and meta information.
